## LegatorOCR 0.2.0-pre.73 — phone-capture helpers, tables that always come out, faster previews

### Added
- **Unusable frames in `--burst`**: frames with a hand over the lens, black frames, dull flat frames and frames with far less detail than the rest of the session are listed (`looks unusable`). `--burst-drop-unusable` also leaves them out. A blank page of the book is never flagged, and when every frame looks unusable none is dropped. Thresholds are untuned starting values; what is dropped is always printed.
- **Shooting rhythm**: with EXIF times, `--burst` prints the number of shots, the typical gap between pages, the retakes (an unusable frame followed by a good one) and a suggested timer for the next session.
- **Capture page timer** (`web/capture.html`): shoots every N seconds (start 15 s). A frame that looks unusable is not kept and counts as a retake; two retakes in the last six shots add 2 s, six clean shots in a row take 1 s off (never below 5 s).

### Repaired
- **`#table` zones**: a zone marked as a table now always gives a table in Word, EPUB and Excel, also with a single row or a single column. Until now a zone with fewer than two rows or columns silently came out as flowing text.
- **Content box numbers (Left / Top / Right / Bottom)** of a sheet cut into two pages showed, and edited, the sheet-wide value while the box of each page is kept separately and wins; the numbers now show one row per page and edit that page's own box.

### Faster
- The list of thumbnails loads one picture per core (two for very large scans) instead of two at a time.
- The next two pages and the previous one are prepared in the background after 150 ms of stillness (was 700 ms, one page).
- The skew search runs its angles in parallel and, with the picture search, side by side with the ink analysis; the grey picture and ink map of the upside-down test are reused by the content step when nothing changed the page in between. Output is byte-identical (checked page by page against the previous build on seven option sets); the gain depends on the number of cores.

### Security (from the adversarial audit of 2026-11-23)
- A project or collection file can no longer choose the program that is run as Tesseract.
- Plugins (wasmi) can no longer grow their memory or tables past the cap.
- Windows: the "show in folder / open" helper no longer goes through a shell.
- The temporary directory of the external PDF renderer is private and unpredictable.

Built and tested by the CI of this release.
